series.label: Night-time radiance, mean, Beirut governorate
series.license: World Bank Open Database License (ODbL), as stated on the AWS Registry of Open Data
series.notes: VIIRS Day/Night Band monthly composites for Suomi NPP, World Bank Light Every Night (s3://globalnightlight/composites/npp_YYYYMM_*), read as windows from the public Cloud Optimized GeoTIFFs and aggregated to the 8 governorates in build/geo/lbn-adm1.json with rasterio (pixel centres inside the polygon). Stray-light-corrected composites (vcm-slcorr / ecm-slcorr) are used; months where only the stray-light-excluded version existed: none. Processing: 2012-01 to 2017-03 is the rp2 reprocessing (vcm cloud mask); 2017-04 onwards is the operational (ops) product, with an ecm configuration for part of the later record, so small level shifts at those boundaries are possible (compare 2017-03 and 2017-04 before reading a trend across them). Radiance is cloud-free monthly mean in nW/cm2/sr; pixels with no data are skipped. Winter months have fewer cloud-free nights over Lebanon. Gaps (no composite in the archive): 2014-03, 2017-10, 2017-11, 2021-08, 2022-06, 2022-08, 2024-10; archive ends at 2025-06.
